From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops sparring session — technical deep-dive & runbook mapping

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for a productive discovery yesterday. ClearPath's scale and the multi-tenant routing constraints you mentioned make this a great candidate for a targeted deep-dive. We'd like to run a 60–75 minute "ops sparring" session with your EngOps and infra engineers to: 

- Walk a proposed topology for serving (routing, fallback tiers, cache policy)
- Surface any network/VPC constraints and data residency requirements
- Co-author a short runbook for the initial POC and performance targets

Proposed time matrix (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue 13 Oct, 09:00–10:15
- Option B: Wed 14 Oct, 11:00–12:15
- Option C: Thu 15 Oct, 15:00–16:15

Agenda draft will include a 15-minute environment overview from your side, 30 minutes of topology and SLO discussion, and 20–30 minutes to map runbook actions.

I'm attaching a concise runbook template we use to kick off these sessions. Can you confirm which slot works and who from ClearPath should join? If none of these fit, tell me the teams' best 2-hour windows and we'll do a quick matrix.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear options and the runbook template. Option B (Wed 14 Oct, 11:00 PT) looks promising for our core EngOps group, but two caveats:

2) We also want a short (10–15m) pre-brief with our infra team to ensure the right artifacts are ready (VPC peering info, existing firewall rules, sample traffic profile). Can someone from Redwood join that pre-brief?

Participants from our side likely: Ishan Patel (Network), Priya Menon (Infra), myself. 

If we do B we can try to shift the internal conflict, but if that looks tight for Redwood, Option A (Tue 13 Oct, 09:00 PT) is our fallback.

- 09:30–09:50: Redwood pre-brief (Karthik, Ben) w/ ClearPath infra point (Priya) — quick artifacts check
